text:
priya: Quick sync — we need to finalize Q3 private-deploy gating so Eng/Product can lock OKRs. Customers pushed for VPC control plane + on-prem packaging + airgap support. Can we list must-have vs nice-to-have?

sam: +1. Also need clear rollback/fallback policy if control plane is unreachable in airgapped installs.

maya: Must-haves (from infra/customer calls): control-plane API parity (management + metrics), bootstrap agent with local KV, signed offline bundles, KMS/HSM integration, upgrade path without internet, minimal debug/diagnostic dump.

oliver: Nice-to-haves: GUI installer, multi-cluster orchestration, automatic OS-level CVE scanning. Those can be phased.

priya: Thinking of phasing: Phase A = control-plane-lite (VPC control plane for managed customers) + agent-based on-prem runtime + signed offline bundle for airgap customers. Phase B = full private control plane option + richer GUI packaging features. Thoughts?

anna: Risk — packaging team capacity is the bottleneck. If we require SHA-signed images + reproducible build infra for airgap, that adds ~3 weeks unless we scope down.

cheng: Suggestion: scope Phase A packaging to a deterministic tarball installer + step-by-step CLI install. Defer GUI and automated OS hooks to Phase B. Keeps package simple and testable for offline.

sam: For control-plane integration gating, propose the following acceptance checklist:```- Control plane API version v1: health + metrics + user mgmt endpoints
- Agent registration flow offline + online fallback
- KMS shim (local HSM or KMS bridge) tested in CI
- Signed bundle verification at install
- Upgrade path verified with sample customer dataset (no internet)```

priya: That looks good. Add SLA/latency targets for control plane interop? Enterprise sales will need numbers. Maybe soft targets for Phase A (e.g., 99.5% management API availability for hosted control plane).

maya: Also capture telemetry constraints: for airgap installs we need an explicit telemetry policy boolean (opt-in) and the agent must support a local metrics sink. Legal asked for explicit wording.

anna: Implementation tradeoff: if we build control-plane-first, packaging may be blocked on API shapes. If we start with packaging-first (agent + offline bundle) we can run a local control-plane shim that implements minimal API to validate installer UX. Which do we prioritize?

oliver: Recommend parallel workstreams: runtime+agent packaging team focuses on deterministic offline bundles + agent UX; control-plane team stabilizes v1 management APIs. Sync points every Wed. Keep API surface minimal to avoid blockers.

priya: Decision: run parallel with weekly sync. Owners: @anna — packaging & offline bundles; @maya — control-plane API stability; @cheng — security/KMS integrations; @oliver — rollout runbook & fallback policy.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: PRIV-842 "Phase A offline bundle + agent install checklist" assigned to anna.

sam: Action items: 1) Anna to share initial offline bundle prototype by EOD next Tue. 2) Maya to publish v1 API contract (openapi snippet) in the repo by Fri. 3) Cheng to validate KMS shim design and provide risk doc (2 pages) in 10 days. 4) Oliver to draft rollback/fallback runbook with diag commands.

priya: Priorities for roadmap/OKRs: tie Phase A to OKR: "Private Deploy GA readiness" with key results: one pilot customer onboarded airgapped, packaging automation (repro builds), and control-plane v1 stability.

anna: Quick note — packaging will need a signing key rotation plan for offline delivery. I'll add that to PRIV-842.

maya: I'll post the OpenAPI snippet in #eng-runtime and link it here once ready.

oliver: Can someone confirm legal/compliance acceptance criteria for airgap customers (export controls / data residency)? If not, we should flag it as gating.

priya: Good call — adding Legal sign-off as a gating item. @cheng can you coordinate?

cheng: Yep, will loop in legal. I expect some paperwork for HSM/KMS use and data flow diagrams.

sam: One more risk: support burden — offline installs generate more tickets. We should budget 1 FTE in SRE/support for Phase A launch window.

priya: Ok. I'll add staffing ask to the roadmap doc. Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with parallel streams + owners. If objections, reply with concerns.

maya: :thumbsup:

anna: :thumbsup: will deliver prototype

oliver: :thumbsup:

cheng: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

priya: Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap tracker and create the OKR epic.
